title: Distributed rate-limit policy and state
purpose: Correct source diagram's mistaken client-as-rule-source and show disk rules loaded into cache separately from Redis runtime counters and 429 decisions.
alt: 디스크 규칙→작업 프로세스→규칙 캐시의 설정 경로와 레디스 공유 상태·API 허용·429 거부 경로
requiredChecks: Control path is Rules on disk→Rule-loader workers→Rule cache; no client is mistaken for rule storage.
Middleware reads Rule cache and atomically checks/updates separate Redis counters/timestamps.
Client request→Middleware→API servers only if Allowed, with explicit rejected HTTP429 response to Client.
Rule cache and runtime Redis state are distinct; loader workers are not on the synchronous API request path.
